label: thm:cartan
scope_in_this_package: Quoted Cartan–Tkachev classification. The binary theorem gives harmonicity and the orthonormal complex normal form in dimension two for every eikonal constant c>0. The harmonic theorem at a chosen unit idempotent of the cubic product (the mark) identifies Cartan's cubic in dimension at least three for c=1. Its isometry also takes each chosen unit vector in the minus eigenspace to the prescribed vector of the model. The nonharmonic theorem proves Tkachev's full reducible normal form for every c>0, including the exclusion of dimension two. The capitalized predicate TkachevNonharmonic states that nonharmonic clause.

label: cor:second-row
scope_in_this_package: With the identifications of Tits's magic-square construction as input, the octonionic row has negative-definite real Killing form, and its complexification is isomorphic to the complex Chevalley algebra of type E₆. The proof gives an isomorphism of real Lie algebras from the real row onto the real Lie subalgebra fixed by any compact conjugation of the complex Chevalley algebra of type E₆. The fixed subalgebra uses the inherited bracket and restriction of scalars from the complex Chevalley algebra. The chosen model is independent of the proof of existence of a compact conjugation. The other conclusions give the ranks, the fixed real algebras of conjugation, the unique stable Cartan subalgebra lifts and the bijection between orthogonal decompositions into Cartan subalgebras.
